Name: Ichthyodelphis - Opossum Fish
Author: tigerchatoyance
Description:
This li'l fella is a [b]nocturnal creature[/b] who is prone to wander, so it migrates around depending on the season. In the [b][color=#6aa84f]Spring[/color][/b], it prefers to spend time in a lightly forested area in an enclosed water source as the weather begins to warm up. When [b][color=#f1c232]Summer[/color][/b] rolls in, the Ichthyodelphis migrates to higher elevations where the cooler temperatures keeps it from overheating. However, when [color=#ff7700][b]Fall[/b][/color] comes, it can be seen in areas with moving water that sweep in more sources of food while it prepares for winter, though most of that food is human junk food. Finally, in [b][color=#6d9eeb]Winter[/color][/b], it migrates to a quieter, more enclosed location to weather the cold. The rare Ichthyodelphis, despite it's rather passive temperament, will put up quite a fight for [b]anglers of intermediate skill[/b] and upwards.

See full, detailed spawn requirements in the spoiler below!

[spoiler]During the [b][color=#6aa84f]Spring[/color][/b], it can be found in the [b]Cindersap Forest pond[/b].
During the [b][color=#f1c232]Summer[/color][/b], it can be found in the [b]Mountains[/b].
During the [b][color=#ff7700]Fall[/color][/b], it can be found right in [b]Town[/b].
And during the [b][color=#6d9eeb]Winter[/color][/b], it can be found in the [b]Secret Woods[/b].

Between 7:00 PM and 2:00 AM.
You also need minimum Fishing lvl 5.[/spoiler]

[b]**NEW** [/b]The Albino Ichthyodephis, while still sharing its cousin's seasonal migration, is even more elusive and only appears in the true dead of night and only under special circumstances. Even [b]experienced[/b] anglers will have a tough time landing this rare, feisty fish.

[spoiler]Between 10:00 PM and 2:00 AM.
Requires Fishing lvl 10.
Appears only while Mr. Qi's Extended Family quest is active.

NOTE: It behaves as any other Extended Family fish and can be caught multiple times, so if you see more than one, it's intended![/spoiler]


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Once you catch this wonderful creechur, you can either give it a home in a fish tank, or place it in a Fish Pond, where it will generate fishing Baits for you! Never have to worry about keeping your Fishing Pole or Crab Pots stocked again! The Ichthyodelphis is a livebearing animal and thus [b]does not produce roe [/b]naturally.

[spoiler]The baits produced are an equal 30% chance of normal Bait (15-25), Deluxe Bait (15-25), Wild Bait (15-20), Magic Bait (10-15 ONLY if recipe is unlocked), and a 10% chance of Challenge Bait (10-15 ONLY if recipe is unlocked).[/spoiler]

[b]**NEW** [/b] The Albino Ichthyodelphis will generate treasures for you in a Fish Pond in the forms of Omni Geodes, Mystery Boxes, and even Golden Mystery Boxes. Similar to the original, it [b]does not produce roe[/b] naturally.

[spoiler]70% chance of Omni Geodes (5 at a time), Mystery Boxes at 40% (3-5), and Golden Mystery Boxes at 30% (maximum 1 at a time ONLY if the player has Foraging Mastery unlocked).[/spoiler]


Disclaimer: Mods that tamper with Fish Pond data may result in unexpected side effects. :D If you play with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24356]Aquarism[/url] installed, you are so good at fishkeeping that you somehow manage to persuade these marsupial fish to give you roe. ~*Magic*~
